payload.text: hv's end-to-end test, 2026-11-04: bin/devbin release --patch in pplr (2.0.2), Cldr (0.2.2) and ccusage (0.1.8), one after another, then Molt 1.4.1 (todo 12) and molt upgrade --self && molt upgrade && molt maintain on rhadamanth, gyges and kovacs. Before each go: the tip verified in a fresh clone with the stamped run (vc's scratchpad verify-main.zsh <tag> for pplr; cldr-vc and ccusage-vc for theirs); a dry run in the shared checkout itself (porcelain empty, and only the two NOT REACHED lines: a third names dirt the stamp would refuse); that project's nodes frozen (no wb verb or pickup there); a slot booked for hv. After each: hv's brew upgrade and --version, the slot released, the freeze lifted, hv pushes the record commits. At 09:02Z: pplr 4b521af verifying in slot 01M6JWM8AJ4VEQT4DVNGCGDSMA; ccusage 27709bc verified by ccusage-vc, which is frozen, while ccusage-dc commits its dirty board and freezes; Cldr waits for cldr-dc's 0.2.2 notes (with cldr-vc's R1 and R2) and its board commit, then cldr-vc's stamped verify. pplr-dc does Molt's liberator after hv's compact.
